hazards.control: Bleed the tubing and casing to zero and verify before breaking any connection.

name: Standing valve
function: The ball and seat in a cage at the bottom of the barrel: open on the upstroke to fill the barrel, closed on the downstroke to hold the column.

tabs.overview: Same ball-and-seat family as the traveling valve; retrievable with the pump.
tabs.safety: A leaking standing valve lets the column fall back on the downstroke.
tabs.evidence: PetroWiki sucker-rod lift, ESP, and gas lift pages (S39, S40, S41); API 11AX, 11E, 11S, 11V (S43 to S46); field practice (S9). Generic geometry; not an OEM design.
